awsMarketplace.description: Sync your AWS Marketplace customers, subscriptions, and billing data securely using an IAM role. Flexprice only accesses the permissions you explicitly grant, and verifies the connection before enabling sync.
awsMarketplace.connectionNameInfo: Choose a name to help identify this AWS Marketplace connection inside your workspace.
awsMarketplace.connectionNameHint: A descriptive name for this connection.
awsMarketplace.step1Title: Step 1 — Create an IAM role in AWS
awsMarketplace.step1Hint: Create a new IAM role in your AWS account using the policies below. They grant Flexprice only the permissions required to sync your AWS Marketplace subscriptions, customers, and billing information.
awsMarketplace.iamPolicyInfo: Specifies exactly what AWS Marketplace resources Flexprice can access.
awsMarketplace.trustPolicyInfo: Allows Flexprice to securely assume this IAM role using the External ID below.
awsMarketplace.externalIdInfo: This unique identifier protects against the Confused Deputy security issue by ensuring only your Flexprice workspace can assume this IAM role. You don't need to copy it separately — it's already included in the Trust Relationship above.
awsMarketplace.accountIdInfo: Flexprice's AWS account that your IAM role will trust. It's already included in the Trust Relationship above.
awsMarketplace.accountIdMissing: Not configured. Set VITE_FLEXPRICE_AWS_ACCOUNT_ID so the trust policy can be generated.
awsMarketplace.step2Title: Step 2 — Enter your IAM Role ARN
awsMarketplace.roleArnInfo: Paste the full ARN of the IAM role created in your AWS account. We'll verify that it can be assumed before saving.
awsMarketplace.roleArnHint: We'll validate the role before saving the connection.
awsMarketplace.regionInfo: The AWS region your product's Marketplace Metering Service is enabled in. Defaults to us-east-1 — AWS Marketplace assigns this to every SaaS product unless you specifically requested a different region.
awsMarketplace.regionHint: Only change this if AWS confirmed your product uses a different metering region.
awsMarketplace.variablesHint: Copy each value to fill the matching {VARIABLE} placeholder in the Trust Relationship above. The values stay hidden here and are only revealed once pasted.

gcpMarketplace.description: Run the setup script in your GCP project, then paste the resulting credentials JSON here. Flexprice verifies it before saving.

gcpMarketplace.step1Title: 1. Run this script in your GCP project's Cloud Shell
gcpMarketplace.step1Hint: It creates a Workload Identity Federation pool, a service account, and grants it exactly the permission needed to report usage. Expand to review before copying.
gcpMarketplace.scriptInfo: Creates a Workload Identity Federation pool, provider, and service account in your GCP project, scoped to report usage only.
gcpMarketplace.variablesHint: Copy each value to fill the matching {VARIABLE} placeholder in the setup script above. The values stay hidden here and are only revealed once pasted.
gcpMarketplace.accountIdInfo: Flexprice's AWS account that your Workload Identity Federation provider trusts. It's already included in the setup script above.
gcpMarketplace.roleNameInfo: The AWS role name your Workload Identity Federation provider's attribute condition checks against. It's already included in the setup script above.
gcpMarketplace.accountIdMissing: Not configured. Set VITE_FLEXPRICE_AWS_ACCOUNT_ID and VITE_FLEXPRICE_AWS_ROLE_NAME so the script can be generated.
gcpMarketplace.step2Title: 2. Paste the credentials JSON the script produced
gcpMarketplace.credentialsJsonInfo: The credentials file the script produced. Flexprice uses it to authenticate into your GCP project without storing a long-lived key.
gcpMarketplace.credentialsJsonHint: The full contents of the file the script wrote (flexprice-gcp-creds.json)

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.description: Send invoices, calculate tax, and collect payments using our native connector to Stripe.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The Flexprice Stripe app enables invoicing, tax collection, and payment via Stripe.

stripeInvoicing.title: Stripe Invoicing
paragraphs: Create and send invoices through Stripe Invoicing directly from Flexprice and automatically collect payments.

automaticTax.title: Automatic Tax Calculations
paragraphs: Leverage Stripe Tax to handle complex tax rules and rates for any region. The integration ensures accurate, up-to-date tax calculations for each invoice, removing the guesswork and reducing compliance risks.

securePayments.title: Secure and Flexible Payments
paragraphs: Collect payments quickly and securely via Stripe's trusted payment gateway. Your customers can choose from various payment methods - credit card, ACH, and more - to improve the overall customer experience and speed up cash flow.

razorpay.name: Razorpay
razorpay.description: Accept, process and disburse payments using our native connector to Razorpay.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The Flexprice Razorpay app enables invoicing, tax calculations, and payment collection directly through Razorpay. Integrate it seamlessly with Flexprice (or your billing engine) to streamline your payment workflows.

razorpayInvoicing.title: Razorpay Invoicing
paragraphs: Create and send invoices with a few clicks - right from Flexprice - using Razorpay's invoicing capabilities. Payment collection can be automated, reducing manual follow-ups.

automaticTax.title: Automatic Tax Calculations
paragraphs: Leverage Razorpay's support for regional tax rules (e.g., GST in India). This integration ensures accurate, up-to-date tax rates for each invoice, minimizing compliance risks and manual calculations.

securePayments.title: Secure and Flexible Payments
paragraphs: Collect payments quickly and securely via Razorpay's trusted payment gateway. Your customers can choose from various methods - credit cards, debit cards, net banking, UPI, and wallets - enhancing the payment experience and accelerating cash flow.

chargebee.name: Chargebee
chargebee.description: Sync invoices and charges/prices between Flexprice and Chargebee for seamless billing operations.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The Flexprice Chargebee app enables seamless synchronization of invoices and charges/prices between Flexprice and Chargebee. Integrate it to streamline your billing workflows.

invoiceSync.title: Invoice Sync
paragraphs: Sync invoices from Flexprice to Chargebee, ensuring your billing system stays up to date with the latest invoice data.

chargePriceSync.title: Charge and Price Sync
paragraphs: Synchronize charges and prices between Flexprice and Chargebee to maintain consistency across your billing platform.

hubspot.name: Hubspot
hubspot.description: Hubspot is a CRM, sales, marketing and customer service platform.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The Flexprice HubSpot app enables seamless syncing of deals, invoices, customers, and payments between HubSpot and Flexprice.

dealLineItems.title: Deal Line Items Sync
paragraphs: Automatically sync deal line items from HubSpot to Flexprice, ensuring accurate revenue tracking and billing.

invoiceSync.title: Invoice Sync
paragraphs: Push invoices from Flexprice to HubSpot to keep your CRM up to date with billing information.

customerSync.title: Customer Sync
paragraphs: Sync customer data between HubSpot and Flexprice to maintain a single source of truth for customer information.

paymentsSync.title: Payments Sync
paragraphs: Keep payment records synchronized between both platforms for accurate financial reporting.

revenueReporting.title: Revenue Calculations on HubSpot
paragraphs: Leverage HubSpot's reporting capabilities with accurate revenue data synced from Flexprice.

salesforce.name: Salesforce
salesforce.description: Salesforce is a customer relationship management (CRM) platform.

paypal.name: PayPal
paypal.description: PayPal is an online payment system that supports online money transfers.

zoho.name: Zoho
zoho.description: The Zoho Books integration lets you manage critical accounting tasks directly from Flexprice.

createCustomer.title: Create Customer in Zoho Books
paragraphs: Automatically create or update customers in Zoho Books whenever a new customer is added or modified in Flexprice.

createInvoice.title: Create Invoice in Zoho Books
paragraphs: Generate Zoho Books invoices seamlessly from Flexprice usage data or billing triggers, reducing manual work.

transformInvoice.title: Transform Flexprice Invoice to Zoho Books Invoice
paragraphs: Convert a Flexprice invoice object into Zoho Books' invoice format - streamlining data flow and ensuring accuracy.

quickbooks.name: QuickBooks
quickbooks.description: Sync plans, customers, and invoices from Flexprice to QuickBooks Online for seamless accounting operations.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The Flexprice QuickBooks integration enables one-way sync from Flexprice to QuickBooks Online. Automatically sync plans, customers, and invoices to keep your accounting system up to date.

planPriceSync.title: Plan/Price Sync
paragraphs: Automatically create QuickBooks Items (Service type) when plans are created in Flexprice. Each price is mapped to a QuickBooks Item for accurate invoice line items.

customerSync.title: Customer Sync
paragraphs: Customers are automatically created in QuickBooks when invoices are synced. Customer data including name, email, and billing address is synchronized.

invoiceSync.title: Invoice Sync
paragraphs: Automatically sync invoices from Flexprice to QuickBooks Online. Invoice line items are mapped to QuickBooks Items, ensuring accurate accounting records.

tokenRefresh.title: Automatic Token Refresh
paragraphs: OAuth tokens are automatically refreshed by the backend when they expire, ensuring uninterrupted sync operations without manual intervention.

nomod.name: Nomod
nomod.description: Send invoices and collect payments using payment links through Nomod integration.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The Flexprice Nomod app enables invoicing and payment collection through Nomod payment links. Integrate it seamlessly with Flexprice to streamline your payment workflows.

invoiceSync.title: Invoice Sync
paragraphs: Create and send invoices with payment links through Nomod directly from Flexprice. Payment collection can be automated through Nomod payment links.

paymentLinks.title: Payment Links
paragraphs: Generate secure payment links for your invoices using Nomod. Your customers can pay quickly and securely through various payment methods supported by Nomod.

webhooks.title: Webhook Integration

whop.name: Whop
whop.description: Sync invoices to Whop with automatic payment status updates.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The Flexprice Whop integration lets you push invoices directly to Whop as one-time send_invoice payments. Customers can pay via the Whop-hosted checkout page, and Flexprice is automatically updated when payment is received.

invoiceSync.title: Invoice Sync
paragraphs: When invoice sync is enabled, Flexprice automatically creates a corresponding invoice in Whop whenever a Flexprice invoice is finalized. The integration ensures your Whop product exists (creating one if needed).
You can also mark a Whop invoice as paid from Flexprice, which calls the Whop mark_paid API on your behalf.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
paragraphs: Register the Flexprice webhook URL in your Whop developer settings, subscribe to invoice.paid, and use the same webhook signing secret in Flexprice. When Whop fires this event, Flexprice verifies the signature, marks the corresponding invoice as paid, and records the payment.

invoiceSync.title: Invoice Sync

aws_marketplace.name: AWS Marketplace
aws_marketplace.description: Report metered usage to AWS Marketplace so your AWS buyers are billed for what they consume.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: Flexprice reports the usage you already meter to AWS Marketplace on your behalf. Connect the marketplace-metering IAM role from your own AWS account, and Flexprice takes care of sending BatchMeterUsage for each registered agreement.

setup.title: Setup
paragraphs: Create an IAM role in your AWS account using the IAM policy and trust policy shown in the connection panel. The trust policy grants Flexprice's AWS account permission to assume the role, scoped to a unique external ID. Paste the resulting Role ARN back into Flexprice and save — Flexprice verifies the role by assuming it before storing the connection.

usageReporting.title: Usage Reporting
paragraphs: Once connected, an hourly job aggregates usage per agreement and reports it to AWS via BatchMeterUsage, with a daily reconciliation pass as a backstop.

gcp_marketplace.name: GCP Marketplace
gcp_marketplace.description: Report metered usage to GCP Marketplace so your GCP buyers are billed for what they consume.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: Flexprice reports the usage you already meter to GCP Marketplace on your behalf. Flexprice authenticates to your GCP project using Workload Identity Federation — no long-lived GCP key is ever stored — and sends the usage report for each registered entitlement.

setup.title: Setup
paragraphs: Run the setup script shown in the connection panel from your GCP project's Cloud Shell. It creates a workload identity pool trusting Flexprice's AWS identity and a service account scoped to report usage only. Paste the resulting credentials file back into Flexprice and save — Flexprice verifies the connection by exchanging it for a live token before storing it.

usageReporting.title: Usage Reporting
paragraphs: Once connected, a scheduled job aggregates usage per entitlement and reports it to GCP via the Service Control API's services.report.

azure_marketplace.name: Azure Marketplace
azure_marketplace.description: Report metered usage to Azure Marketplace so your Azure buyers are billed for what they consume.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: Flexprice reports the usage you already meter to Azure Marketplace on your behalf. Connect an Entra ID app registered in your own Azure tenant, and Flexprice sends the usage event for each registered subscription.

setup.title: Setup
paragraphs: Register an app in your own Microsoft Entra ID tenant and generate a client secret for it. Make sure this app's tenant ID and application ID are entered on the Technical Configuration page of every offer you want usage reported for. Paste the tenant ID, client ID, and client secret back into Flexprice and save. Flexprice verifies the credentials by requesting an access token before storing the connection.

usageReporting.title: Usage Reporting
paragraphs: Once connected, a scheduled job reports usage per subscription to Azure Marketplace's usage event API.
